I’m Sidali, a software engineer based in Algeria. I like understanding how things work and finding ways to improve them.

My work connects frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure. I’m currently building transaction services and operational tools at Yassir, with experience across commerce, AI workflows, and full-stack product development.

Applied mathematics at the University of Boumerdès is part of my background. Beyond product work, I’m drawn to cybersecurity, CTF challenges, networking, self-hosting, and open source.
